title: Enable remote login (SSH) on Mac
summary: Turn on the SSH server so you can connect to your Mac from another computer. This is often needed for remote administration or file transfers.

steps.explain: Enable the remote login service using the systemsetup command.

rollback.explain: Disable remote login to secure the Mac again.

warnings: Enabling SSH allows other computers to connect to your Mac. Ensure you have a strong password or SSH keys configured.
